wish: someone should make a 3D game where you play an ant avoiding people stepping on you
spec:
Top-down floor game: you are an ant, shadows of feet grow and then stomp.
Drag on the floor to steer the ant out of the shadows; your score is seconds survived.
It is not 3D, has no sound and no levels; the best time is kept on this device.
notes: Drawn top-down in 2D canvas; depth is suggested by growing shadows, not true 3D.
